chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about salat (prayer) in a black cap.
So he said: “Do not pray in it, for it is the attire of the people of the Fire.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship being discussed

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while wearing a black cap?
ai.summary: This hadith records a ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام discouraging salat (prayer) in a black cap. The reason given is that it resembles the attire of the people of the Fire, linking outward dress in worship to spiritual symbolism.
